newsitem.title: USA: Pulte sees $110 million in tax benefits.
newsitem.headline: Pulte sees $110 million in tax benefits.

text.p: Pulte Corp said Monday it will recognize, in its financial statements as part of discontinued operations, after-tax income of about $110 million in the third quarter of fiscal 1996.
This income relates to a previously-disclosed gain related to tax benefits associated with certain government-reimbursed covered-asset losses, the company said in a statement.
Pulte, the nation's largest homebuilder, operates in 25 states and 40 markets across the country, as well as Puerto Rico and Mexico. It also operates ICM Mortgage Corp, a national mortgage bank.
